candidates.source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: The only body representing banks in SK; ~24 member banks covering ~99% of the sector. Its membership page enumerates the entire addressable bank universe in one place, and the site hosts positions, statistics and standards work.
candidates.legal_status: public information, copyright applies to texts
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of members and news/positions sections; entity extraction of bank names; RSS/news-page polling monthly
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia zoznam bánk
sbaonline.sk stanoviska tlačové správy členovia banky zoznam

candidates.source_name: SBA — Projekty a štandardy (projects and standards)
candidates.why_relevant: Sector-level standards and joint projects (payments, instant payments, e-ID/authentication, data exchange) name the schemes and technical standards SK banks are adopting — the closest thing to a public roadmap of collective bank IT initiatives.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page + attached PDF harvest, diff on change; extract standard/scheme names and participating institutions
queries_used: sbaonline.sk stanoviska tlačové správy členovia banky zoznam

candidates.source_name: SBA — Tlačové správy (press releases) and Štatistiky a analýzy
candidates.why_relevant: Sector commentary and recurring statistics (e.g. payment-card issuance and acceptance series compiled with NBS data from SBA members) give both market-context and named-project signals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Category-page pagination crawl, monthly; store PDFs
queries_used: sbaonline.sk stanoviska tlačové správy členovia banky zoznam

candidates.source_name: SBA Educa (association training arm)
candidates.why_relevant: Association-run certification/exams for financial intermediaries; course catalogues and lecturer lists indirectly reveal which systems, regulations and vendors are considered mainstream in SK banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Occasional manual review of course catalogue
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia zoznam bánk

candidates.source_name: ITAS — IT Asociácia Slovenska, member directory
candidates.why_relevant: Largest SK ICT association, 100+ member companies, filterable by category (infrastructure/cybersecurity, system integration/software, telco, vendor/distributor, consulting). This is the single best enumeration of the IT vendor and integrator universe that sells into SK banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape directory incl. category facets; snapshot quarterly and diff to detect new entrants/exits
queries_used: ITAS IT Asociácia Slovenska zoznam členov

candidates.source_name: ITAS — news, position papers and working groups
candidates.why_relevant: ITAS statements on eGovernment, cybersecurity (NIS2), AI and procurement name the standards and systems being adopted, and reveal which member firms lead which agenda.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: News-feed crawl monthly; NER on company names
queries_used: ITAS IT Asociácia Slovenska zoznam členov

candidates.source_name: SAPIE — Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy, member lists
candidates.why_relevant: ~200 member companies/organisations across the innovation and digital-economy ecosystem, split into regular and associated members; captures fintech and digital challengers that ITAS misses.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape generalmembers/regular-members pages quarterly
queries_used: SAPIE Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy členovia zoznam

candidates.source_name: LobbyFacts / EU Transparency Register entries for SK associations
candidates.why_relevant: Transparency-register datacards disclose association budgets, declared members, lobbying priorities and EU files followed — a cross-check on self-published member lists and on which regulatory topics associations actually spend money on.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query EU Transparency Register API/site by country=SK and sector; annual refresh
queries_used: SAPIE Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy členovia zoznam
AmCham Slovakia members directory financial services committee

candidates.source_name: AmCham Slovakia — members directory and committees
candidates.why_relevant: Directory of members (annually updated, with business descriptions) plus ~15 committees/working groups (Digital Committee, Tax, Public Procurement, Rule of Law). Membership and sponsorship of AmCham events is a weak but real signal of who sells into SK financial services.
candidates.access_status: open web; printed directory may be members-only in full form
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape our-members and press-room; capture event sponsor logos from event pages
queries_used: AmCham Slovakia members directory financial services committee

candidates.source_name: British Chamber of Commerce in the Slovak Republic (Britcham) — members
candidates.why_relevant: ~120 member companies; UK-linked financial services and consultancies active in SK. Complements AmCham for a different vendor cohort.
candidates.access_status: open web; event platform on Glue Up

candidates.source_name: Slovensko-nemecká obchodná a priemyselná komora (AHK Slowakei / DSIHK)
candidates.why_relevant: ~375 member companies across sectors including services and finance; German-linked vendors and banks (and their SK subsidiaries) surface here. Board/officer roles are explicitly split by function including finance.
candidates.access_status: open web; full member database may require login
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/semi-automated review of member and event pages; note the legacy dsihk.sk domain as an alias

candidates.source_name: SBCB — Slovak Banking Credit Bureau (operator of SRBI register)
candidates.why_relevant: Bank-owned credit bureau (founded by Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka with CRIF); ~17 member institutions. The member list enumerates lending institutions, and the CRIF relationship is a named vendor dependency in SK bank credit infrastructure.
candidates.access_status: open web (public pages); register data itself restricted by law
candidates.legal_status: public corporate pages; register content protected (banking secrecy, GDPR) — do NOT attempt data access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape only public 'o nás'/members pages; treat register content as out of scope
queries_used: Slovak Credit Bureau SRBI Nebankový register klientskych informácií členovia

candidates.source_name: NBCB — Non Banking Credit Bureau (operator of NRKI)
candidates.why_relevant: Interest association of non-bank lenders (~32 members) operating the NRKI register and exchanging data with SRBI since 2015. Its member list maps the non-bank consumer-credit and leasing universe — a distinct buyer segment for POS/credit systems.
candidates.legal_status: public corporate pages; register data protected
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape members/o nás pages semi-annually
queries_used: Slovak Credit Bureau SRBI Nebankový register klientskych informácií členovia

candidates.source_name: ALS SR — Asociácia leasingových spoločností Slovenskej republiky, riadni členovia
candidates.why_relevant: ~32 bank-owned, independent and captive leasing/instalment companies plus associated members; publishes quarterly volume press releases (EUR 3.357bn financed in 2023). Enumerates a whole adjacent financial-institution buyer segment.
candidates.access_status: open web, incl. PDF press releases
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member pages; harvest /sites/default/files/documents PDFs quarterly
queries_used: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR členovia; Slovenská asociácia poisťovní členovia

candidates.why_relevant: Insurance association with member categories (riadni, pridružení, stáli pridružení, osobitný štatút); the associated-member tiers typically include service providers and vendors selling into insurers — a direct vendor-discovery lever. candidates.why_relevant: Statutory bureau of motor insurers, closely tied to SLASPO (shared LinkedIn presence). Membership is compulsory for MTPL insurers, so its list is an authoritative census of that segment; it also procures shared IT systems.

candidates.source_name: SASS — Slovenská asociácia správcovských spoločností
candidates.why_relevant: 7 full and ~18 associated members in collective investment; the associated-member tier is where custodians, distributors and IT/data vendors appear. Bank-owned asset managers link back to the bank universe.

candidates.why_relevant: Active fintech/insurtech association with a membership page; enumerates the challenger and technology-provider cohort that neither SBA nor SLASPO covers.

negative_findings.description: AmCham Slovakia does not appear to run a dedicated 'Financial Services Committee'. The standing committees found were Civil Code Task Force, Business-Academic Cooperation, Digital, Employment and Social Affairs, Energy, Health Care, Public Procurement Task Force, Rule of Law Initiative and Tax.
negative_findings.result_summary: The seed-query assumption of an AmCham financial-services committee is not supported; the Digital Committee and Tax Committee are the nearest relevant bodies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should target the Digital Committee outputs rather than waiting for a financial-services committee that may not exist; avoids a permanent empty watchlist entry.

negative_findings.description: Slovenská FinTech asociácia (slovakfintech.sk) and Slovensko-nemecká obchodná a priemyselná komora do not expose a complete public member list in search-visible form; only officers, aggregate counts or partial lists were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Membership must be reconstructed indirectly via the state register of interest associations (rez.vs.minv.sk), FinStat/Transparex, or event sponsor pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Directory-diffing pipelines will produce false 'no members' results for these bodies unless the indirect route is configured.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'SIBA' as a Slovak blockchain/investment association did not resolve to any real organisation in SK searches; 'SAPI' resolves to the sustainable-energy association, not fintech.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching these acronyms returns unrelated bodies; the real blockchain actors are Blockchain Slovakia and Slovenská kryptomenová asociácia.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Flags SIBA and SAPI as noisy/false-friend acronyms that must be excluded from SK query templates to avoid polluting the actor map.

negative_findings.description: No SK association was found to publish an explicit list of technology vendors serving banks, or sponsor lists in a machine-readable form. Sponsor identification will depend on event pages and PDF programmes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sponsor-based vendor discovery is possible but manual/semi-structured across SBA, ITAS, AmCham, Britcham and AHK event pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for the collection routine: sponsor logos are images and PDFs, needing OCR rather than HTML parsing.

negative_findings.description: SBCB (SRBI) and NBCB (NRKI) credit-register content is protected by banking secrecy and GDPR; only corporate/member pages are collectible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public 'o nás' and member pages are fair game; register data is not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a compliance incident if a downstream collector treats these domains as generally scrapable.

coverage_gaps.description: Member directories for ITAS, SAPIE, AmCham, Britcham, SLASPO, ALS SR, SASS, FINAS and SBCB/NBCB were identified but their full member rosters were not enumerated in this pass — only counts and sample names.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated extraction pass that fetches each directory page (including category facets and pagination) and writes a normalised member table with IČO resolution.

coverage_gaps.description: Employer/business umbrella bodies (Republiková únia zamestnávateľov, AZZZ SR, Klub 500, Slovenská obchodná a priemyselná komora) and the banking ombudsman were not searched in this cell; several banks and large IT firms sit on their bodies.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map with RÚZ, AZZZ SR, SOPK, Klub 500 and Bankový ombudsman and run one SK-language pass over their member/section pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Associations of financial intermediaries and payment institutions (e.g. bodies representing finanční agenti / poskytovatelia platobných služieb) were not located; the intermediary channel is a distinct buyer of POS and onboarding technology.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search SK terms 'asociácia finančných sprostredkovateľov', 'samostatný finančný agent', 'platobná inštitúcia združenie' and cross-check against the NBS register of regulated entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Association conference/event sponsor lists — the strongest 'who sells into SK banking' signal in this cell — were not collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate annual events (SBA conferences, ITAS ITAPA-adjacent events, AmCham/Britcham galas) and OCR sponsor pages/programmes for vendor names.

coverage_gaps.description: The URL for Slovenská kancelária poisťovateľov (skp.sk) was inferred rather than observed in results, and the ass.sk vs as3.sk distinction for asset-manager associations needs disambiguation (as3.sk is 'Asociácia správcov a správcovských spoločností', a different body concerning insolvency administrators).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Verify both domains in the deterministic liveness pass and disambiguate the two 'správcovské' associations before merging their members.

brief: Slovakia's association layer is unusually well-suited to actor enumeration: SBA covers ~24 banks and ~99% of the sector with 14 expert commissions plus a public projects-and-standards section, while ITAS (100+ ICT members, filterable by systems integration / cybersecurity / vendor-distributor) and SAPIE (~200 innovation-economy members) between them enumerate most of the vendor universe selling into SK finance. Adjacent collective bodies extend the map into non-bank buyers — ALS SR (~32 leasing companies), SLASPO (insurers plus associated service-provider tiers), SASS, FINAS, and the two credit bureaux SBCB/SRBI (~17 bank members, CRIF-backed) and NBCB/NRKI (~32 non-bank members) — with the chambers (AmCham, Britcham, AHK Slowakei) and Digitálna koalícia adding sponsor- and commitment-level signals of who partners with whom. Most member rosters are published as open HTML and are diffable quarterly; the main gaps are that sponsor lists live in images and PDFs, a few bodies (Slovenská FinTech asociácia, AHK) publish no full roster and must be reconstructed via the state register of interest associations or FinStat, and credit-bureau register content is legally off-limits even though the corporate pages are not. Note also that AmCham Slovakia has no financial-services committee (the Digital and Tax committees are the relevant substitutes), and 'SIBA'/'SAPI' are false-friend acronyms in this market.
